title: 第1777章 兽王产仔第1776章 剑下留人
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
玄龙城，李家府邸深处。
魂灯大殿外，两名守门执事正百无聊赖地闲聊。
突然，大殿厚重的铜门被人从里面撞开，一名负责看守魂灯的弟子连滚带爬地冲了出来，脸上毫无血色，活像白日见鬼。
“快！快去禀报家主！出大事了！”
这名弟子声音凄厉，双腿发软直接瘫在台阶上。
不到半盏茶的功夫，李家家主李冲天带着几名实权长老，脚踏狂风降落在魂灯大殿门前。
李冲天阴沉着脸，一脚踹开大门，大步跨入殿内。
入眼的一幕，让这位执掌李家数十年的枭雄，心脏猛地停滞了一瞬。
大殿正中央，原本供奉着李家核心精锐的数十盏本命魂灯，此刻竟然熄灭了一大半。
而在最高处的那几盏金漆魂灯中。
代表着李家二小姐李暮蝉，以及大长老李狂澜的两盏魂灯，早已碎成了满地残渣，连一丝火星都没剩下。
“大长老、二小姐……都陨落了？”
跟进来的几名实权长老倒吸一口凉气，声音都在发颤。
李狂澜可是半步空源境的顶级强者，放眼整个玄龙城，除了城主聂雄风，谁有本事将他击杀？
更何况，他还带着李家整整一半的精锐去探索秋狩秘境。
现在魂灯大面积熄灭，这意味着李家进入秘境的队伍，已经被人全歼！
“查！给我查清楚到底是谁干的！”
李冲天双目赤红，周身空源境的源气罡风失控般席卷而出，将殿内的几张紫檀木桌椅震得粉碎。
愤怒过后，随之而来的是一阵令他遍体生寒的恐惧。
玄龙城各大势力本就互相倾轧。

如今李家折损了一半精锐，连大长老都折在了里面。
一旦这个消息走漏，王家和那些虎视眈眈的二流势力，绝对会像闻到血腥味的恶狼一样扑上来，将李家撕成碎片。
“封锁魂灯大殿！今日之事，谁敢对外吐露半个字，杀无赦！”
李冲天咬紧牙关，迅速冷静下来。
“传讯给玉清宫的明旭长老，还有早年欠我李家人情的几位散修强者。告诉他们，李家愿意出双倍的价钱请他们出手！”
李冲天转过头，看向几位噤若寒蝉的长老，眼神狠毒。
“带上家族剩下的所有死士，随我去秘境出口守着！不管是谁杀了我李家的人，老夫都要扒了他的皮！”
……
秋狩秘境，九玄山脉核心区域。
穿过层层毒瘴，一片巨大的环形谷地呈现在众人眼前。
谷地四周的山壁上，已经零零散散地汇聚了数百名修士。
这些都是从外围成功杀进来，抵达核心区寻求机缘的各方世家精锐。
苏铭揽着聂清秋的纤腰，脚踏暗黑色气旋，从远处的密林上空轻盈降落在一处视野开阔的凸起岩石上。
两人的到来，立刻引起了周围不少人的注意。
“咦？那是城主府的队伍吗？怎么只有聂大小姐一个人？”
“跟在她身边的那个黑袍青年是谁？好眼生的面孔。”
众人交头接耳，目光在四周扫视，很快发现了一件令人诧异的事情。
玄龙城老牌三大家族之一，陈家早就在秘境开启前被灭，这已经不是秘密。
可一向行事高调的李家大部队，竟然直到现在连个鬼影子都没看见。
核心区域的这批顶尖势力中，只剩下王家的人马占据着东北角的一块高地。

此时，不少世家子弟并未在意李家为何没来，注意力早已放在了聂清秋的身上。
毕竟聂清秋的貌美容颜，在玄龙城说是第二，但无人敢称第一。
但很快，让这些大少们目瞪口呆的一幕出现了。
只见那位平日里高傲得犹如冰山雪莲、连正眼都不屑看男人的城主千金，此刻竟然从储物戒中取出一枚晶莹剔透的灵果。
她伸出葱白般的玉指，细心地剥去果皮，动作轻柔得像是个乖巧的贴身丫鬟。
content_en:
Xuanlong City, deep inside the Li family's mansion.
Outside the Soul Lantern Hall, two gatekeepers were chatting boredly.
Suddenly, the thick bronze door of the main hall was knocked open from the inside, and a disciple responsible for guarding the soul lamp rushed out crawling on the ground, his face was bloodless, as if he had seen a ghost in the daytime.
"Quick! Go and report to the head of the family! Something big has happened!"
This disciple's voice was shrill, his legs were weak and he collapsed on the steps.
In less than half a cup of tea, the head of the Li family, Li Chongtian, led several powerful elders and landed in front of the Soul Lantern Hall with their feet on the strong wind.
With a sullen face, Li Chongtian kicked open the door and strode into the hall.
The sight that caught his eye made the heart of this powerful man who had been in charge of the Li family for decades stop for a moment.
In the center of the main hall, dozens of natal soul lamps that were originally dedicated to the core elite of the Li family were more than half extinguished at this moment.
And among the golden paint soul lamps at the top.
The two soul lamps representing Li Muchan, the second young lady of the Li family, and Li Kuanglan, the eldest elder, had long been shattered into debris on the ground, with not even a spark left.
"The First Elder and Second Young Lady...have all fallen?"
The powerful elders who followed took a deep breath, their voices trembling.
Li Kuanglan is a top expert in the Half-Step Kongyuan Realm. Looking at the entire Xuanlong City, except the city lord Nie Xiongfeng, who has the ability to kill him?
What's more, he also took half of the elite members of the Li family to explore the secret realm of Qiu Shou.
Now that the soul lamps are extinguished in large areas, this means that the Li family's team that entered the secret realm has been completely wiped out!
"Check! Find out who did it!"
Li Chongtian's eyes were red, and the Origin Qi of the Sky Origin Realm around him swept out like an uncontrollable force, shattering several rosewood tables and chairs in the hall.
After the anger, there followed a wave of fear that chilled him all over.
The major forces in Xuanlong City are already at odds with each other.
Now the Li family has lost half of its elite, including the great elder.
Once this news leaks out, the Wang family and those second-rate forces who are eyeing him will definitely pounce on him like wolves smelling blood and tear the Li family into pieces.
"Seal the Soul Lantern Hall! Anyone who dares to tell anyone about today's events will be killed without mercy!"
Li Chongtian gritted his teeth and quickly calmed down.
"Send a message to Elder Mingxu of Yuqing Palace and several strong casual cultivators who owed me favors from the Li family in the early years. Tell them that the Li family is willing to pay double the price for their help!"
Li Chongtian turned his head and looked at the silent elders with vicious eyes.
"Take all the remaining dead men of the family and follow me to guard the exit of the secret realm! No matter who kills someone from my Li family, I will skin him!"
…
Autumn Hunting Secret Realm, the core area of Jiuxuan Mountains.
After passing through the layers of poisonous miasma, a huge circular valley appeared before everyone's eyes.
Hundreds of monks have gathered scattered on the mountain walls around the valley.
These are the elites from various families who have successfully fought their way in from the periphery and reached the core area to seek opportunities.
Su Ming held Nie Qingqiu's slender waist, stepped on the dark black cyclone, and landed lightly on a raised rock with a wide view from the distant dense forest.
The arrival of the two people immediately attracted the attention of many people around them.
"Huh? Is that the team from the City Lord's Mansion? Why is Miss Nie the only one?"
"Who is the young man in black robe following her? What a strange face."
Everyone whispered to each other, glanced around, and soon discovered something surprising.
It is no secret that the Chen family, one of the three oldest families in Xuanlong City, was destroyed long before the secret realm was opened.
But the Li family's large army, which has always acted in a high-profile manner, has not even seen a ghost until now.
Among the top forces in the core area, only the Wang family's men were left occupying a piece of high ground in the northeast corner.
At this time, many children of the aristocratic families did not care why the Li family did not come, and their attention had already been focused on Nie Qingqiu.
After all, Nie Qingqiu’sShe is said to be second in beauty in Xuanlong City, but no one dares to call her number one.
But soon, a scene appeared that stunned these young men.
I saw that the daughter of the city lord, who was usually as arrogant as an iceberg and a snow lotus, and didn't even bother to look at a man, actually took out a crystal clear spiritual fruit from the storage ring.
She stretched out her green-white jade fingers and carefully peeled off the peel, her movements as gentle as a well-behaved personal maid.
